Offset vs keyset pagination

Offset pagination skips rows. Keyset pagination uses the last seen ordered key to continue, avoiding large
offsets for suitable indexes.
OFFSET එක records ගෙණනක් skip කරෙනවා. Keyset එක කලින් page එJක් අන්තිම key එJකන් ඊළඟ

Interview question: Why prefer keyset for large lists?
Answer: It can seek through an index instead of skipping many rows.
